_doc: ISTQB-partitioned test data for the consolidated Smart Stock In screen (/MobileViewScreen/smart-stock-in). Keys grouped by technique per cypress/qa/SKILL.md §9. Replaces the retired stockInItems.json / addByProduct.json / stockInProducts fixtures when the 4 Stock-In destinations merged into Smart Stock In (2026-06).

quantity._doc: EP/BVA partitions for the selected-product Quantity field. The input strips non-digits on change (Frontend/src/components/SmartStockIn/index.tsx:1615), so alpha is filtered client-side and 0/negative are rejected by submitQuantity().

emptyScanError: Scan or enter a serial number

containerLocation._doc: Config-gated Container/Location Assignment (enableContainerLocationAssignment). Container capacities and stock-in quantities chosen for BVA around the capacity boundary and for exact accumulation checks. Containers/locations/POs are all API-seeded per run — no key here is an environment id.
